title: Final Potential Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for potential energy V(r) must be correctly stated as V(r) = -m h^2 / (2r^2).

title: Use of Binet's Formula
description: Important Criteria: The application of Binet's formula to relate force and the trajectory must be correctly derived.

title: Correct Integration
description: Important Criteria: The integration process to find potential energy from the force must be correctly executed.

title: Definition of Variables
description: Optional Criteria: Clear definitions of variables such as r, u, and h should be provided for clarity.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should maintain consistent units throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the derivation will lead to a deduction.

title: Missing Steps
description: Pitfall Criteria: Omitting key steps in the derivation, such as the transition from force to potential energy, will result in a deduction.
